# pritunl_subscription (Resource)

The subscription resource activates a Pritunl license on the instance. It is a singleton: one instance of it maps to the whole Pritunl cluster. The license key is write-only — the Pritunl API never returns it — so the key lives in the Terraform state as a sensitive value and a changed key replaces the resource. Activation is validated by the Pritunl host against `app.pritunl.com`, which the host must be able to reach.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The license key is a secret: feed it from a secret store rather than
# writing it into the configuration.
data "azurerm_key_vault_secret" "pritunl_license" {
  name         = "pritunl-license"
  key_vault_id = data.azurerm_key_vault.keyvault.id
}

resource "pritunl_subscription" "main" {
  license = data.azurerm_key_vault_secret.pritunl_license.value
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `license` (String, Sensitive) The Pritunl license key to activate. Write-only on the Pritunl API; a changed key replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `plan` (String) The subscription plan the instance reports.
- `quantity` (Number) The licensed quantity the instance reports.
- `status` (String) The subscription status the instance reports.
